caseNameFull: Herrera v. Collins, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Institutional Division
judges: Blackmun, Certiorari, Connor, Grant, Motion, Stevens, Writ

opinions.text:
Motion to treat the application for stay of execution as a petition for writ of certiorari denied.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, Justice O’Connor, and Justice Souter would grant the motion and would grant the petition for writ of certiorari.
